post.message: Door starts down, then pops right back up? Before you assume the opener is dead, get down at floor level and look at the two little photo eyes on either side of the door. In Miami, sprinkler overspray, cobwebs and a bumped bracket are all it takes to break the beam. Wipe the lenses, check that both lights are steady, and never tape over a sensor to force the door shut. The step-by-step checklist is in our newest guide.
